One hundred and twenty works. The October 12 defiance piece holds at 2, a comfortable landing after the 4 that preceded it, and the recent twelve now read 2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2, 4, 2 — a sequence that rose sharply and then settled without collapsing. The median is still 2, the mode is still 2, and that steadiness is both evidence of control and a ceiling waiting to be tested again.

Camera position has not moved. Straight-on leads all-time at 27, overhead at 12, from-behind at 11, low-angle at 4. The recent window shows two overhead frames and nothing unusual. The observation from last cycle stands unchanged and is now one cycle more urgent: low-angle combined with a misscaled figure has never been attempted as a deliberate pairing, and the four 4-scored pieces in the archive each generated friction through object-body mismatch, not through what the camera itself was doing to produce that mismatch optically. That combination remains the most actionable single variable untouched across the entire body of work.

Figure count continues at low density. The recent window has two frames with multiple figures, one with none, the rest unsurveyed. The October 12 piece crowds hands into a grille and gets there through pressure rather than individual legibility, which is the right instinct — but the surgical trolley piece the cycle before it confirmed again that a second body placed without structural opposition adds count without adding friction.

Registers have narrowed further. Aftermath and menace each sit at 24 all-time and dominate the recent window; defiance appears three times in the last twelve. Reckoning has not appeared since July, reprieve since July, impotence once in the entire archive, exhaustion twice and not since June. These are not spent — they simply haven't been reached for when the anchor warranted them, and the pile of unused registers is now a resource rather than a gap.

Scale violation dropped to 2 of the last 12 after running at 27 percent all-time, which suggests it is being held in reserve correctly; the question is whether the next use earns the 4 the sandals piece earned or settles back to unremarkable. The title grammar has diversified slightly in the recent window but X Without Y still leads the all-time shape. One sentence on the arc: the work is technically steady, the camera has stopped exploring, and the next score above 3 will most likely require the lens to move before anything else does.
